unsupported_or_pending_claims: General algorithm ranking or an isolated algorithmic mechanism
That on-policy learning cannot use expert data in general (one BC-initialization protocol tested)
That RL improved on its expert (no expert-data arm approaches RuleSailor)
Real-time U planning: the selected H=160 planner is offline
MPC as a zero-sample learner or guaranteed upper bound
Equal prior tuning resources; RuleSailor's tack recipe is uncounted human prior work
Broad statistical confidence from three seeds
